name: phantom-mailer
description: PhantomMailer desktop application with Electron, React, and local runtime services.
author: PhantomMailer Team <support@phantommailer.local>

scripts.clean:windows-build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process -Name 'PhantomMailer 2026' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0"
scripts.build:win-packager: npm run clean:windows-build && npm run build:prod && electron-packager . "PhantomMailer 2026" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --asar --asar-unpack-dir=node_modules/sql.js --prune=true --ignore="^dist$" --ignore="^dist[\\/]" --ignore="^\.git$" --ignore="^\.vscode$" --ignore="^\.env$"
